doctrine: Machine-enforceable design law. This is what stops 'cantik but drift'.

red_usage.forbidden: red outside /arif strip, verdict chips, seal marks, VOID states
red_usage.enforce: scan rendered CSS for red hex outside allowed scopes

max_torus_per_view.note: two toruses per page is a design VOID
max_torus_per_view.enforce: DOM scan for torus markers per route

forbid_local_palette.note: no page-local color tokens; all from canon/design-tokens.json
forbid_local_palette.enforce: scan for hardcoded hex in page CSS

forbid_unregistered_hero.note: every route hero must be in canon/page-instruments.json

require_channel_field.note: every JSON surface must declare channel (human/institution/earth/sovereign)

require_state_enum.note: tactile state must be explicit, never implicit

contrast_floor.value: AA >= 4.5:1 for actions, AAA >= 7:1 for text
contrast_floor.note: a color that fails contrast is a constitutional violation, not a style bug

one_family_per_territory.note: a stray card from another family inside a territory is a border incident

motion_rationing.value: clock + pulse are the only things that move on mains
motion_rationing.note: a fake 'live' animation is hantu - F9 violation

live_must_be_real.note: every dynamic element backed by real data (clock, snapshot, sentinel). Stale must say 'stale - sealed <ts>'

prefers_reduced_motion.value: every hero degrades to silence: static sealed frame with timestamp
